src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Demo data loader
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Fills a fresh, empty database with sample farm data for development, and does nothing if data already exists.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Sample data outcome
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Reports whether loading sample data created data, found it already there or failed.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: accounts
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that sets up the farm account and its settings.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: staff
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that creates the staff of managers, sales, workers and read-only users.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Load-test data loader
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Fills a database with a realistic made-up farm, with staff, flocks and history, for load testing and screen tests.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: flocks
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that creates flocks, their layout and a flock-limited worker.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: inventory
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that creates inventory and stock movements.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: summary and counts
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that tallies what was created and checks it against expected counts.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: expected counts
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that works out how many records of each kind should exist.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: pre-checks
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that checks the database is in a fit state before loading.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: egg history
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that creates past daily egg production entries.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Test data: sales
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Part of the load-test data loader that creates customers and sales orders.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Load-test data settings
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: Settings that control how much made-up data the load-test loader creates.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.name: Load-test loaded marker
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Persistence.description: A saved note that load-test data was loaded, so loading again does not guess from existing records.
